name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began in his early teens, tinkering with engines in his father's garage in rural Wales. He served his apprenticeship at a local engineering firm before joining a small rally team, where he honed his skills in fabrication and problem-solving under pressure. He quickly developed a reputation for his meticulous approach and ability to craft robust, reliable components, regardless of budget constraints.

He joined GCK Motorsport 15 years ago, drawn by their commitment to innovation and their challenging rally raid projects. Gareth thrives on the precision required to meet the demands of off-road racing. He’s known for his practical solutions and his unflappable demeanor, even when faced with seemingly impossible deadlines. He brings a wealth of experience and a deep understanding of materials science to the team, making him an invaluable asset in the workshop.

Gareth's perfectionism borders on obsessive, often resulting in superior build quality. While he prefers to work independently, he is always willing to share his knowledge and mentor younger team members. His pragmatic approach ensures that designs are not only innovative but also practical and durable, contributing significantly to the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A stout man with calloused hands and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an impossibly fine point.
Drinks exactly three cups of strong tea before starting any major project.
Has a habit of muttering technical specifications under his breath.
